basic_info.description: Exceptional Value/Deal! Tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac lies the historic Mullen Building, a 1920s gem comprising 16 distinctive live/work lofts designed by architect George Hauser. This exceptional corner residence boasts an expansive adaptable living space featuring soaring ceilings, large triple pane windows & abundant natural light, setting a tranquil & welcoming ambiance. The loft includes two bathrooms, oversized primary suite & versatile spaces ideal for a home office. The elegantly updated kitchen features modern cabinets, countertops, a new sink & a stylish backsplash. Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer/dryer, ample storage & a designated parking space. This turnkey opportunity includes the option to purchase Designer's furnishings for a seamless move-in experience. Elevator access in the 73 Sumner building leads to a shared rooftop deck offering breathtaking Downtown views. Centrally located w easy access to premier shops & dining spots in SOMA/Yerba Buena/South Beach. Whether you prefer strolling, cycling, or immersing yourself in the vibrant neighborhood, this loft epitomizes urban living at its finest. Close to Embarcadero Waterfront, Oracle Park, Chase Center, chic bars & eateries, Wholefoods, Caltrain/Muni & EZ freeway access to East Bay/Peninsula
